conclusion.original: Difference of actual marginal test means equals the signed integral of marginal drift means.

scopes.original: Signed interval; spatial drift sections are integrable a.e. in restricted time, with totalized values at any exceptional time.
scopes.reconstructed: Uses the same iterated integral, leaving the convention at exceptional inner sections implicit.
scopes.evidence: Lean uses the totalized real Bochner integral. Fubini gives integrable inner sections a.e. and the signed outer integral is insensitive to the exceptional values. This does not add any sectionwise hypothesis.
